label: Maturina
summary: Female servant of Leonardo at Cloux, named in the will of 1519.

value.text: Bequest in the will of 23 April 1519

claims.statement: The will leaves 'Maturina sua fantesca' a cloak of good black cloth lined with fur, a further piece of cloth and two ducats, in reward for her service.

sources.cite: Richter, The Notebooks of Leonardo da Vinci, section 1566 (text of the will, English), online mirror. Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

Amoretti, Memorie storiche su la vita, gli studj e le opere di Lionardo da Vinci (1804), page image on Wikisource (Italian text of the will). Seen in a web search result summary only; the page was not opened in this session.

open_questions: The research brief lists a 'Mathurin (servant)'. The will names a woman, Maturina. No male servant Mathurin was found.
